checks.text_art_safe_insets: All learner copy readable on clear centers; no props, folds, rings or frames obscure teaching words.
checks.face_action_crops: Teaching faces, hands, actions and answer-bearing objects remain visible in this scope.
checks.response_space: All visible answer lines/table rows/open writing surfaces complete; no response/Extra Practice intersection seen.
checks.contrast: Dark live copy and coloured role labels remain readable on white/light interiors; saturated exterior materials carry character.
checks.distortion: No awkward raster stretching or skewed live teaching copy found.
checks.adult_warmth_variety: Distinct food, cloth, fridge, tailoring, parcels, calendars, travel, architectural, signpost, cinema and gift worlds go beyond a repeated palette or generic blank card. Ordinary practice remains calm and readable.

limitations: This is a visual saved-PDF proof of the stated 28 pages, not an audio-listening review or claim that other PDF pages were inspected here. A later PDF revision needs page identity/hash carry-forward or a fresh affected-page proof.

carry_forward.decision: PASS carried forward to final native PDF
